name: scry
description: Session-start checks for codebase architecture, the running stack, repository health, concurrent agent activity, and machine pressure.

interface.shortDescription: See repository and machine state at session start
interface.longDescription: Adds quiet, advisory session-start context about codebase architecture, the stack the system actually runs on (read from live config, not from documentation), repository hygiene, concurrent Claude and Codex activity, and local machine pressure.
defaultPrompt: Use Scry to check the state of this workspace.
